crossRefs.note: Every one them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The…
They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings…
It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces;
so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm…
The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man…
The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.

translations.web: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
translations.bsb: Each had four faces and four wings, with what looked like human hands under their wings.
translations.kjv: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
translations.asv: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
